definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese festival celebrating children's growth, held on November 15th for children ages 3, 5, and 7.

⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{七歳|ななさい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦なので→なので：noentry⟧、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七五三|しちごさん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Since my daughter is seven years old, this year we have Shichi-Go-San.

notes:
USAGE: {七五三|しちごさん} is a traditional Japanese rite of passage celebrating children at ages 3, 5, and 7. The name literally means "7-5-3" after these ages.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- ⟦{三歳|さんさい}→歳：10017_sai⟧ - Both boys and girls celebrate at age 3
- ⟦{五歳|ごさい}→歳：10017_sai⟧ - Boys celebrate at age 5
- ⟦{七歳|ななさい}→歳：10017_sai⟧ - Girls celebrate at age 7
- Traditionally held on November 15th, but many families visit shrines on nearby weekends
- Children dress in traditional ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧ or formal Western attire

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {七五三|しちごさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧ (Shichi-Go-San celebration)
- {七五三|しちごさん}⟦{参|まい}り→参る：01322_mairu⟧ (Shichi-Go-San shrine visit)
- {七五三|しちごさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ (Shichi-Go-San photos)

- ⟦{千歳飴|ちとせあめ}→千歳飴：29353_chitoseame⟧ - special long candy symbolizing longevity, given to children
